SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.DOCNUM + '-' + Cast(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) DOCKEY ,S.DOCNUM SRCDOC ,S.SRCDOC ORIDOC ,S.DOCLIN SRCLIN ,S.DOCTYP SRCTYP ,H.DEPT ,S.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,BPS.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,S.ITMVER --产品版本 ,ITM.TSICOD1 ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,T1.OPTDES OPTDES1 ,T2.OPTDES OPTDES2 ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, S.REQDAT, 23) REQDAT ,S.UOM --采购单位 ,Cast(S.UOMCOE AS REAL) UOMCOE --采购单位系数 ,( S.QTY - Isnull(P.PORQTY, 0) ) QTY --采购单位数量 ,S.STU --库存单位 ,( S.QTYSTU - Isnull(P.PORQTYSTU, 0) ) QTYSTU --库存单位数量 ,S.REMARK LREMARK ,ITM.IVATTYP ,S.FAC ,BPS1.BPSNAM ,PLIST.PRI NETPRI ,0{6} TAXRT FROM PREQUL S LEFT JOIN PRILIST PLIST ON PLIST.PRICD1 = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T1 ON ITM.TSICOD1 = T1.OPTID AND T1.OPTTYP = 'TSICOD1' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T2 ON ITM.TSICOD2 = T2.OPTID AND T2.OPTTYP = 'TSICOD2' LEFT JOIN PREQUH H ON S.DOCNUM = H.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN (SELECT L.SRCDOC ,L.SRCLIN ,Sum(L.QTY) PORQTY ,Sum(L.QTYSTU) PORQTYSTU FROM PORDLIN L INNER JOIN PORDER R ON L.DOCNUM = R.DOCNUM WHERE Isnull(R.CLOREA, '') + Isnull(L.CLOREA, '') = '' --排除手动关闭的记录 AND L.SRCTYP = 'PRQ' GROUP BY L.SRCDOC ,L.SRCLIN)P ON P.SRCDOC = S.DOCNUM AND P.SRCLIN = S.DOCLIN LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON S.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO LEFT JOIN [BPSUP] BPS1 ON BPS1.BPSNO = PLIST.PRICD2 WHERE S.DOCSTA = 2 AND Isnull(PINNUM, '') = '' --选择未询价的记录 AND S.QTY - Isnull(P.PORQTY, 0) > 0 AND H.SITE = '{0}' AND S.ITMNO LIKE N'%{1}%' AND S.ITMVER LIKE N'%{2}%' AND ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMSPEC + ITM.ITMSIZE LIKE N'%{3}%' AND ( PLIST.PRICD2 = '{4}' OR '{4}' = '' ) AND ( PLIST.CUR = '{5}' OR '{5}' = '' ) AND ( CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Getdate(), 21) BETWEEN PLIST.STRDAT AND PLIST.ENDDAT OR Isnull(PLIST.STRDAT, '') = '' ) ORDER BY REQDAT DESC
